dogecoin.text: We've just had a claimed partnership brought to our attention; the Foundation hasn't partnered with anyone yet, and any future partnerships would be announced through official accounts. Please be careful who you believe.

Very cool fireside chat happening right now with @MyDogeCEO at #DogeCon2024. 
https://t.co/HSGfa8N6QU

We're almost 11 years old & just keep throwing spare change at each other over the internet.

Remember that 1 Ð = 1Ð
Much wow.

Dogecoin started as a joke, but became the good (light) heart of the crypto community.
Without any kind of pre-allocation or IPO, DOGE is truly a people's currency where everyone can contribute.

Right now, we're working hard on #Dogebox which makes it even easier to run your own full node of Dogecoin, to accept Dogecoin, and to develop your own solutions on top of it. 
https://t.co/kZW7Daw6hM

The Foundation is funded entirely by donations & takes care of some of the infrastructure supporting Dogecoin & works to make it easier to interact with & build upon DOGE with projects such as #libdogecoin & #Gigawallet.
https://t.co/Gg9SmGCevT
https://t.co/rvUkEmaAoq https://t.co/6BJmnQk9Uh

We'd like to remind everyone that @Dogecoin is an open-source project based on the code of #Bitcoin and that virtually all development of Dogecoin is done by volunteers.

A small number of core developers & contributors also work here at the Dogecoin Foundation. https://t.co/GjKCowNOLd

We're glad this is finally over.
We took on defending uninvolved core developers, founders, & community members initially named in this suit & were glad to have them removed early on, but we could've imagined much nicer uses for high five figures in legal fees spent on this.
